relationships.subject: Nav1.8 expressing corneal afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: Results indicate LGE-induced persistent, ongoing pain, driven by Nav1.8 expressing corneal afferents.

relationships.subject: ArchT
relationships.evidence_quote: After LGE, Nav1.8-cre;ArchT/eGFP mice demonstrated a preference for the ArchT activating light paired chamber.

key_findings: Optogenetic inhibition of Nav1.8+ corneal afferents produced place preference after lacrimal gland excision, indicating ongoing dry eye pain.
Topical QX-314 plus lidocaine prevented the preference.
